description: The test-failure record (ids, excerpts, classification, failure signature) is written by Stage 3, the Stage 4 resolver and the review-loop local tests, but never by Stage 5: when the final-head CI check at Stage 5 finds failing tests, nothing records their ids, excerpts or signature. A signature that repeats across runs is also never promoted to the knowledge base, so the same failure mode is diagnosed again from scratch.
goal: Add a stage_5 stage constant to sandbox_executor/entrypoint/test_failure_record.py and, in sandbox_executor/flow/github/ci_reverify.py, record a test failure row through record_test_failure when the Stage 5 final-head CI check reports failing tests, using the failing test ids and excerpts parsed from the failed check output. Then, in sandbox_executor/knowledge/wisdom.py, promote a failure_signature that appears in two or more recorded test-failure rows of different runs to a knowledge-base failure_mode entry (once per signature, with the failing ids and the classification), using the existing failure_modes knowledge-base format. Do not change the Stage 3, Stage 4 or review-loop wiring. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: A failure recorded at every stage, and a repeated signature remembered, lets the next flow classify the same failure in one diagnosis instead of re-deriving it.
acceptance_criteria: A failed test run in any stage produces ledger rows with the failing ids, excerpts and classification: a test in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_stage5_test_failure_record.py drives the Stage 5 final-head check in apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/github/ci_reverify.py with a real failed-check output containing two failing pytest ids and asserts one test-failure row with stage stage_5, both ids, their excerpts and a classification is appended to the executions ledger.
The same test file asserts a Stage 5 check with no failing tests appends no test-failure row.

A test in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_failure_signature_promotion.py writes two test-failure rows with the same failure_signature from different runs into a temporary ledger and asserts apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/knowledge/wisdom.py creates exactly one failure_mode knowledge-base entry for the signature with the failing ids and classification, and that a signature seen once creates none.
The same test file asserts running the promotion twice does not create a second entry for the same signature.
Existing Stage 3, Stage 4 and review-loop failure-record tests still pass.
A failed test run in any stage produces ledger rows with the failing ids, excerpts and classification.

1 Failed run in any stage writes ledger rows (ids, excerpts, classification) Partial `test_failure_record._row`; wired for Stage 3 (`executor_test_run.default_failure_loop`), Stage 4 (`resolver_test_failure`) and review local tests (`review/local_tests.py`). No Stage 5 test-run wiring in the diff.
All tests pass via 'uv run pytest' and 'uv run task lint' passes.
